theorems.name: Submission.gwe_gjb_gram_symm_psd_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (D : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), Matrix.IsSymm (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (D (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (D (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))) ∧ (∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, 0 ≤ dotProduct x (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (D (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (D (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))) x)) ∧ Matrix.trace (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (D (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (D (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))) = hsNormSq D
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
